title: Guns Craft-Reforged
description: Deep weapon customization, realistic firearms, and immersive combat.
body:
# **<center>Guns Craft-Reforged</center>**
### _**<center>--What is GCR like?</center>**_
## _**Exquisite model：**_
GCR employs models in the more precise gltf format, rendering exquisite and detailed LowPoly-style Mesh models, providing you with a truly unique visual experience.
![photon2-test](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81efe8d7063ada3c6f06f7a30952820709c70a93.png)
## **_Animation and details：_**
GCR has a powerful first-person animation system that not only offers smooth model animations and camera effects, but also enables the linkage of UI effects.
![chamber check](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2324d53e015d5e6edc7b51c6ca7486db98525ed.png)
![mag check](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aff87e6b7a7bf17da807c91e476eff9ff56195f8.png)
## **_Weapon modification：_**
GCR offers a flexible and comprehensive modular tree system. You can replace the grip, handguard of the firearm, install a scope, and even adjust the positions of the accessories on the rail to accommodate multiple accessories!

Each accessory will alter the different attributes of the firearm, turning a gun into an SMG, an assault rifle, or even a DMR.
![gun modifiy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3057644895fa3fdf345c6340ce7d0a1a1cd26d10.png)
![flashlight](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jtL0NCGC/images/bd48f6203b81c2b2d8d7aa7657d8e990a18683f4_350.webp)
![scope](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jtL0NCGC/images/ce65fc25f7d7661c5d080c694914e49318e8c88c_350.webp)
## **_Cool special effects：_**
GCR has added specially designed shader effects to both Vanilla Minecraft and Iris Shaders. When shooting, the muzzle flash illuminates the weapon model and the environment, providing you with an amazing impact sensation and immersive experience!
![effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jtL0NCGC/images/eaabdbcc2e7d02e0dde5836d158033a93efa0f8b.png)
## **_High performance：_**
GCR completely abandoned the original rendering pipeline of MC and redesigned the GPU-based renderer, making it compatible with Iris Shaders. This enabled the game to handle rendering tasks that were previously beyond its capabilities (we have tested the mainstream shader packs and they all run normally).
### _**Note! If you are using YSM (Yes Steve Model), please be sure to turn off the rendering of the little player model on the screen.**_
![vanllia render](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jtL0NCGC/images/97019690a3073811fc9345c5f72828f0bf599a23.png)
![iris shader render](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jtL0NCGC/images/a86ede40cb821686af978e8fb25a36c60edca067.png)
_GCR is currently still under development. More content and mechanisms will be added in the future, and eventually GCR will open an API so that players can create their own gun mods. Thank you for reading this far. Stay tuned!_
